title: A Cozy Autumn Day at Home - Cottage Life Vlog
en: salutations and welcome to my cottage this week i wish to share with you a quiet early autumn day in my home i haven't had a slow day in a while my job has kept me busy so it feels good to take a moment step away from the noise and submerge myself in a day of homemaking i will be baking a variety of sweet treats inspired by the harvest as well as making some very luxurious vanilla extract also at the end of this video i will be answering a few more questions that you've been asking so stay tuned do

do there is something crisp and enticing about the harvest and while it is only just in its infancy over here i'm relishing the little hints of autumn in the air i'm anticipating the first frost the way

it magnifies the scent of the pine needles with that comes a welcoming feeling that i can't quite put into words as if the earth is reaching out and asking you to follow its rhythm to prepare for the cold to take care of your body and mind so that you may rise up again renewed ready for another year of beginnings and possibilities so

i have an abundant tomato harvest this year so i am going ahead and dehydrating the ones i know i won't be able to eat before they spoil they are very useful when adding to soups and stews in the wintertime one of my favorite things about the harvest is the abundance of squash i'm currently growing butternut and last year i grew many delicatas

do not mistake this for a particularly healthy meal it is definitely a dessert but what can i say i have a sweet tooth since no one asked i thought i'd share that i have the strange hobby of making miniature furniture and rooms for what purpose i'm not sure maybe it's for the fairies
so so so firstly i want to say thanks for all the

beautiful and amazing comments that i've been reading on my videos recently though my channel has grown so suddenly that i'm not able to respond to every comment know that i do read them and i love to see all the kindness and insight that people are sharing so in response to all those questions on how do i live this way i want to say that these videos help me feel calm and centered and peaceful they remind me to be in the present because i often fail at practicing that own philosophy i think many of us struggle when our lives are busy and there's a lot on our mind even

though i am so far from perfect i keep practicing mindfulness and being in the present and i always try to center myself when i see that my worries or thoughts are getting away from me every day i improve just a little bit and i think that's enough however i want to reiterate that my videos aren't a realistic portrayal of my daily life i am an artist and i like to see things through the eye of an artist i don't always want to portray things exactly as they are but how they could be i do live here and i love where i live i love to make crafts and bake and spend time with my pets and paint and go on

walks all these things are true but i also have a job i have a boyfriend i have family and my mother lives next door and i spend so much time with her it's not even funny there are so many moments living here where i become overwhelmed i worry i am anxious about anything and everything even in the middle of nowhere you cannot outrun your humanity last but not least thank you to everyone who has supported me through my etsy shop recently it means the world it is such a wonderful support to have and it is so encouraging for a crafter and artist like myself i will have new things available in the coming months

it is just the best feeling ever so thank you all for your kind inquiries and questions and compliments and since i've gotten so many questions recently i thought i would ask one to all of you and that is what is some way that you spread kindness in your daily life i think there will be a lot of creative responses to that and i am interested to know what brings you joy and what helps you give joy to other people sending love and light to you and i will see you all next week bye
zh: 问候并欢迎本周来到我的小屋，我希望在家里与您分享一个安静的初秋的一天，我已经有一段时间没有度过一个缓慢的一天了，我的工作让我很忙，所以远离喧嚣并沉浸在一天的家务中感觉很好，我将烘焙各种受收获启发的甜食，并制作一些非常豪华的香草精，也在本视频的结尾，我将回答您一直在问的更多问题，请继续关注
收获的时候有什么新鲜和诱人的东西吗？虽然这里才刚刚起步，但我正在享受空气中秋天的小暗示，我正在期待第一场霜冻
它放大了松针的气味，带来一种我无法用言语表达的欢迎感觉，就好像大地正在伸出手来，要求你遵循它的节奏，为寒冷做好准备，照顾好你的身体和心灵，这样你就可以重新站起来，为新的一年的开始和可能性做好准备。
我今年的番茄丰收，所以我要继续脱水，我知道在它们变质之前我不能吃它们，它们在冬天添加到汤和炖菜中时非常有用，收获中我最喜欢的事情之一是大量的南瓜，我目前正在种植胡桃，去年我种植了许多熟食
不要误认为这是一顿特别健康的饭菜，它绝对是一道甜点，但我能说什么呢，我爱吃甜食，因为没有人问我，我想我会分享我有一个奇怪的爱好，就是制作微型家具和房间，我不确定它的用途是什么，我不确定也许是为了仙女
所以首先我想说谢谢大家
我最近在我的视频上读到了美丽而令人惊叹的评论，尽管我的频道突然发展得如此之快，以至于我无法回复每一条评论，因为我知道我确实读过它们，我喜欢看到人们分享的所有善意和见解，所以在回答所有关于我如何以这种方式生活的问题时，我想说这些视频帮助我感到平静、集中和平和，它们提醒我活在当下，因为我经常未能实践自己的哲学，我认为我们中的许多人在生活忙碌且有很多事情时都在挣扎甚至在我们的脑海里
虽然我离完美还很远，但我一直在练习正念并活在当下，当我看到我的忧虑或想法每天都在远离我时，我总是尝试集中注意力，我只进步一点点，我认为这已经足够了，但我想重申，我的视频并不是我日常生活的真实写照，我是一名艺术家，我喜欢通过艺术家的眼睛看事物，我并不总是想完全按照事物本来的样子来描绘事物，但它们怎么可能是我住在这里，我爱我住的地方，我爱制作工艺品、烘烤、与我的宠物共度时光、绘画并继续
所有这些都是真的，但我也有工作，我有男朋友，我有家人，我的母亲住在隔壁，我花了很多时间和她在一起，这一点也不有趣，住在这里有很多时候我变得不知所措，我担心我对任何事情都很焦虑，即使在一个偏僻的地方，你也无法超越你的人性最后但并非最不重要的是感谢最近通过我的 etsy 商店支持我的每个人，这意味着世界有如此美妙的支持，对于像我这样的手工艺者和艺术家来说这是如此令人鼓舞我未来几个月将会有新的东西可用
这是有史以来最好的感觉，所以感谢你们所有人的善意询问、问题和赞美，因为最近我收到了很多问题，我想我应该问你们所有人一个问题，这就是你们在日常生活中传播善意的某种方式，我认为对此会有很多创造性的回应，我很想知道什么给你们带来快乐，什么帮助你们给其他人带来快乐，向你们发送爱和光明，我下周再见，再见
